about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover SDV8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover SDV8 was a high-performance diesel variant offered across two generations: the L322 (2001–2012) and the L405 (2012–2021). It uses the TDV8/SDV8, a 4.4-litre V8 diesel that is a sibling to the more common TDV6 and SDV6 engines. The SDV8 was discontinued when the L460 generation launched, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Range Rover SDV8 Engine Compatibility Because the Range Rover SDV8 spans two generations with the same engine family, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts compatibility across other Range Rover variants risks expensive issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (TDV8/SDV8) via registration or VIN Your generation (L322 or L405) Drivetrain and ancillary specification Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic SDV8 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. The Range Rover SDV8 uses the TDV8/SDV8 — a 4.4-litre V8 diesel engine. It was fitted to the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations. How much does a Range Rover SDV8 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my SDV8? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild Range Rover SDV8 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo components, and gaskets as standard on every SDV8 rebuild. Do you supply used Range Rover SDV8 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover SDV8 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover SDV8 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover SDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover SDV8 from 2023 to present. The TDV8/SDV8 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV8/SDV8 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV8/SDV8 rebuild.
